---
title: ""
# reads data/profile.yml: always re-execute.
freeze: false
format:
  typst:
    output-file: cv.pdf
    papersize: a4
    page-numbering: false
    margin:
      top: 1.5cm
      bottom: 1.5cm
      left: 1.8cm
      right: 1.8cm
    font-size: 10pt
    template-partials:
      - typst-template.typ
      - typst-preamble.typ
      - typst-show.typ
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r cv-typst}
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source(here::here("_helpers", "profile_render.R"))

# AI / scientific software variant. Keeps the cv.pdf filename so existing links
# (LinkedIn, mail signature, UIs that deep-link the CV) keep resolving.
profile <- load_profile("ai")

cat("```{=typst}\n")
cat(render_cv_typst(profile))
cat("\n```\n")
```
